name: 三界神话完整加强版
english_name: Myth of the Three Realms: Enhanced Complete Edition (Quanzhou)
english_description: The fifth and final build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, sjshv150, sjshv2578bb, and sjshwzb) — an enhanced edition sharing sjshwzb's Quanzhou map and core system files almost exactly, differing mainly in operational details such as starting with an empty wizard list rather than a pre-seeded one.
